evidence.claim: ProvisionableAppEntity is the generic application registry and stores chart, identity, child pipeline, step config, secret, config-builder, default-plan and availability policies while excluding chart contents, catalogue and tenant data.
The reviewed registry seed defines multiple applications with distinct chart, identity and pipeline values, including a deliberately non-provisionable MMO row.
Generic fulfillment resolves and gates a registry row, creates an app-bound instance and derives identity from the row without adding a new product enum branch.
ChartSourceService resolves the instance app's chart ref and version from the registry and refuses missing or unresolved local chart sources before Helm runs.
Fulfillment tests cover generic registered apps, the non-provisionable MMO shape, app-key resolution and refusal before fulfillment effects.
Chart source tests prove different app keys resolve their own chart references and missing chart sources are refused.
The owner requested a production-quality multi-app Apps flow for Học viện Chuyên gia and MMO, each with its own black-red SVG logo, backed by seeded data when provisioning is unavailable.
